assessment_mode: read-only; no function was hardened, allowlisted, or deployed
rationale: Every pilot route renders without invoking any edge function.

Pilot pages use the Supabase Auth SDK (signIn, signOut, resetPasswordForEmail) and a direct supabase.from('profiles').insert for onboarding. Auth-SDK calls hit Supabase Auth GoTrue, not the Edge Functions runtime, and are outside the function allowlist scope.

The Layout component that mounts Copilot, health, search-suggestions and zapier background hooks is NOT rendered on any pilot route. The unauth branch of src/App.tsx renders routes bare, without <Layout>.
Therefore zero functions are pilot-required. No 14-column per-candidate assessment matrix is required at this checkpoint.
future_note: If B7.5 re-scopes the pilot to include an approved-user overview, ai-systems-unified (Dashboard) is the smallest candidate set (1 function); ops-overview (IntelligenceDashboard) is a second candidate for analytics/operations. Both require the full 14-column assessment, positive + denial tests, and Layout de-coupling before allowlisting.
